title: 61% of Disney's Profit Comes From One Division
sentence: In the nine months to June 2026, Disney's Experiences division (parks, resorts, cruises, merchandise) made $8.9 billion of its $14.8 billion segment operating income: 61%, on less revenue than movies, TV and Disney+.
source: The Walt Disney Company, Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings release, Form 8-K exhibit 99.1 (August 5, 2026), nine months ended June 27, 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001744489/000174448926000056/fy2026_q3xerxex991.htm
